name: NHHall
description: Stereo-to-stereo reverb by Nathan Ho. Both early and late reflections are true-stereo, blooming outward from the panned input position; random modulation adds lush chorus. Wet-only output — pair with a dry mix and pre/post EQ as needed. Setting rt60 to inf gives an infinite hold reverb. From sc3-plugins NHUGens.

inputs.name: rt60
inputs.description: Approximate 60 dB decay time of the mid frequencies, in seconds. Use inf for infinite hold

inputs.name: stereo
inputs.description: Rate at which audio spreads between L/R. 0 keeps channels separate, 1 blends near-instantly

inputs.name: lowFreq
inputs.description: Crossover frequency between low and mid bands (Hz)

inputs.name: lowRatio
inputs.description: Ratio of low-frequency rt60 to mid rt60

inputs.name: hiFreq
inputs.description: Crossover frequency between mid and high bands (Hz)

inputs.name: hiRatio
inputs.description: Ratio of high-frequency rt60 to mid rt60
